name: usage-planner
description: Plan Codex usage from your current quota, banked resets and public reset evidence.

interface.longDescription: Read your local Codex quota and banked reset deadlines, analyze public Tibo evidence, and open the bundled interactive visual planner with the same result. Requires Node.js 20+ and a locally installed, signed-in Codex CLI. Runs locally; no reset redemption or credit spending. Unofficial; not affiliated with OpenAI.
defaultPrompt: Plan my Codex usage from my current quota.
Can I use more before the next reset?
Plan Codex usage for weekdays only.
